security_audit.summary: The skill documents broad Wonda CLI workflows for media creation, editing, research, and publishing, but it also creates a large external command, network, credential, and social automation surface. Many command findings are real because the skill instructs agents to install packages, run Wonda and local tools, write files, scrape, publish, and automate accounts. I also found high-risk semantic issues around automated social signups, credential vault use, and anti-detection social engagement guidance.

remediation.issue: Social account automation and anti-detection guidance
remediation.suggestion: Remove signup automation, burner account guidance, stealth browser claims, fingerprinting language, and detection-avoidance instructions. Limit workflows to authorized platform APIs and explicit user-approved actions.

remediation.issue: Credential storage and decrypted password retrieval
remediation.suggestion: Avoid storing third-party passwords where possible. Prefer OAuth or scoped tokens, redact all secrets, and prevent agents from displaying decrypted credentials in chat or logs.

remediation.issue: Publishing, messaging, scraping, and engagement commands
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before posting, messaging, following, scraping, or publishing. Add platform policy checks and audit logs for each action.

remediation.issue: External command and package installation surface
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before npm, Homebrew, Wonda, ffmpeg, or browser automation commands. Pin package versions and document network and filesystem effects.
Use workspace-scoped or user-selected output paths instead of fixed /tmp filenames, and avoid overwriting existing files without confirmation.

content.value_statement: Teams need one terminal workflow for media generation, editing, research, and publishing. This skill guides agents through Wonda CLI commands for creation, analysis, and social distribution.
actual_capabilities: Install and authenticate Wonda CLI with browser login or an API key.
Generate images, videos, music, speech, dialogue, and transcriptions through Wonda models.
Edit media with captions, overlays, audio replacement, merges, scene splits, lip sync, and upscaling.
Chain jobs by passing media IDs between generation, editing, analysis, and export steps.
Research social content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn commands.
Publish media and manage connected social accounts through supported Wonda commands.
limitations: Requires Wonda CLI, network access, and valid Wonda account permissions.
Many generation, analysis, and publishing commands may consume paid credits.
Social automation depends on platform rules, connected accounts, and explicit user authorization.
The skill is command guidance, not a sandbox or safety layer for terminal execution.

use_cases.description: Create and edit images, videos, captions, voiceovers, and music for a product launch.

use_cases.description: Gather competitor posts, Reddit discussions, X conversations, and LinkedIn profiles before planning content.

use_cases.title: Finish Media Locally
use_cases.description: Download Wonda outputs and use local ffmpeg workflows for deterministic trimming, captions, audio, and exports.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wonda CLI to create a 9:16 product image for my brand. Ask for any missing product details first.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Social Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second portrait product video with captions and background music. Explain each Wonda command before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Research Before Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Research current competitor and audience signals on X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and Instagram. Summarize findings before proposing creative assets.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Step Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and execute a Wonda workflow that generates media, edits captions, analyzes output quality, and prepares approved assets for publishing.

output_examples.input: Create a short portrait product video with captions for a skincare launch.
output_examples.output: A step plan with model selection, generation prompt, caption approach, audio choice, export path, and approval checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Research Reddit and X for fitness supplement content ideas.
output_examples.output: A trend summary with audience themes, competitor angles, recommended hooks, and suggested Wonda generation workflows.

output_examples.input: Add animated captions and music to this generated clip.
output_examples.output: A media editing workflow that identifies the input media, adds captions, mixes audio, exports the final file, and checks quality.

best_practices: Confirm account, billing, and publishing permissions before running network or social commands.
Use media IDs for intermediate steps and download only the final approved asset.
Prefer local ffmpeg for deterministic edits on files already available in the workspace.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-accept legal, privacy, permission, or publishing prompts without explicit user consent.
Do not use social automation for spam, evasion, account abuse, or unauthorized engagement.
Do not expose API keys, session tokens, passwords, or decrypted credentials in chat or logs.

faq.answer: Yes, it documents publishing commands for supported connected accounts. Publishing should require explicit user approval.

faq.question: Can it run local video edits?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends local ffmpeg for deterministic edits such as trimming, captions, format changes, and audio replacement.

faq.question: What security review is needed before use?
faq.answer: Review command execution, package installation, network calls, credential handling, scraping, messaging, and publishing permissions.

faq.question: Is it suitable for automated social signups?
faq.answer: No. Account creation and social engagement automation should be restricted to authorized, policy-compliant workflows.
